name: ground_terrain
mirror_wall: The ground must be formed and walkable. Flat/unformed terrain fails the Mirror.
input: rung 1 output: habitable planet temp, atmo, gravity, biome
walls: Terrain angle of repose must be 30-45° (stable, walkable)
At least 2 material types must emerge (sand, rock, ice — differential adhesion)
Frozen scaffold (bedrock) must exist as immovable foundation
Player spawn must be on formed, walkable terrain
